notes.text: One sheet showing a shaded frontal figure and a rear view with a red flower and yellow bands. The inscription reads De: Juan and addresses Hoa Hakananaiʻa by name. Only the displayed given name is recorded; no surname or identity match to film participants is inferred. The two views are one artwork, not two objects or sources. The title is editorial. The representation is an unretouched film still at 00:25:02, retaining the original frame composition.
